en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a panoramic view of a town in a valley surrounded by hills. In the foreground there is a stone bridge over a river or ravine, and beyond it dense clusters of traditional low buildings with tiled roofs. Mountains rise in the hazy background. Printed caption text in French appears at the bottom along with a numerical series identifier and the word 'THESSALIE'. A web watermark 'www.ella.org.gr' is superimposed across the lower right.
